Headline: "Oil prices rise after Kuwait says Iran attacked water desalination and power plant"
Dated Friday 17 July 2026. This is the most recent settlement — 18 July 2026 is a Saturday, markets closed.

- Brent crude futures advanced about 4.6% to close at $88.10 a barrel on 17 July 2026.
- US West Texas Intermediate futures gained about 4.5% to settle at $82.49 a barrel.
- Prices rose after Kuwait said Iran struck a power and water desalination plant.
- The Strait of Hormuz typically handles around 20% of the world's oil traffic.
